[지지·저항 구조]

· 스윙 저항선 ($36,570): 피벗 R1($38,625)보다 하단, 20일 이동평균선($35,610) 및 50일 EMA($36,872) 기반

analysis.narrativeEn:
[Trend Position]
· Current Price($35,235) vs SMA5/20/50($37,082/$35,610/$35,598): Below short-term, mixed above/below mid-term, indicating weakening mid-term trend.
· Position vs SMA100($41,541)/SMA200($34,036): Bearish bias in long-term trend.
· 52-week Position (50.7%) + Current price level historically mid-range.
[Momentum Indicators]
· RSI Trajectory (55.1→48.2): Continued consolidation in neutral zone, weak signal for exiting oversold.
· MACD Histogram Trajectory (346.3806→283.9147): Improving but still negative, no trend reversal signal confirmed.
· Bollinger Band Current Price Position (Middle Band $35,610): Bandwidth slowing expansion at 15.37%, consolidating around the middle band.
[Support & Resistance Structure]
· Swing Support ($34,485): Above Pivot S1($32,250), based on 200-day Moving Average($34,036).
· Swing Resistance ($36,570): Below Pivot R1($38,625), based on 20-day Moving Average($35,610) and 50-day EMA($36,872).
· 5-day/20-day High/Low Pattern: Potential Higher Low pattern as 5-day low($35,000) > 20-day low($32,655), no Lower High pattern as 5-day high($39,030) < 20-day high($39,030), consolidation range.
[Volume & Conclusion]
· Volume Ratio (0.48x): Contracted relative to 5-day average, reducing conviction in price movement.
· Current Range Diagnosis (Accumulation Zone): Lack of directionality, meeting conditions for a wait-and-see approach.
